sulfated_ash.calculation_note: Sulfated ash = (Ca_ppm×3.40 + Mg_ppm×4.95 + Zn_ppm×1.24)/10000; elements are in wt.% here, so = 3.40×6.8 (Ca) + 1.24×2.23 (Zn) = 25.8852 → 25.89 wt.%. Mg not reported, taken as 0.
sulfated_ash.notes: Sourced from calculation (ASTM D874 sulfated-ash conversion factors applied to the Ca/Mg/Zn contents in this file), not from the product datasheet.
